# Dejan Petković · AI Engineer & Founder of Elands AI

Dejan Petković is an AI engineer and founder of Elands AI, which designs and delivers intelligent systems for startups and small companies. A Dutch citizen, Dejan started his career as a system engineer in 2008 and over the years built up deep fullstack engineering experience across Python, TypeScript and cloud platforms. That hands-on breadth is what he now brings to AI engineering.

## What I do

- Design and ship LLM-based applications
- Build evaluation infrastructure for LLM systems: evaluation harnesses, LLM-as-judge, guardrails and adversarial testing
- Build real-time AI services
- Prompt design and grounding, MCP servers and agentic tool use
- Full-stack work with TypeScript/Next.js and Python/FastAPI

## Current engagements

- **Elands AI** (Founder & AI Engineer): LLM-based applications, evaluation infrastructure, and real-time AI services for startups and small companies
- **Delphyr B.V.** (Lead AI Engineer, since 07/2025): building an AI platform specifically for the medical field. Leads EHR integrations across four vendors. Now focused on the AI layer: prompt design, guardrails, evals, integrations and observability

## Products & services

- **Biller** (https://biller.elands.studio/): Professional invoicing for freelancers. Create, send, and track invoices in seconds. One-time purchase, no subscriptions.
- **Bouwen** (https://bouwen.elands.studio/): Renovation project communication for the Dutch market. Create a project page, generate a QR code for your window, and let neighbors follow your renovation progress in real time.
- **2e-woning.nl** (http://2e-woning.nl): Box 3 tax calculator to work out the tax on a second home and other investments. Built for the Dutch market.
- **brAIn** (https://github.com/dexpetkovic/brAIn): WhatsApp-based AI assistant built with NestJS and Google Gemini, with an MCP server for storing and retrieving memories.

## Skills

- **AI and LLM systems**: LLM APIs (OpenAI-compatible: Azure ML, Nebius; Google Gemini), MCP servers and agentic tool use, Pydantic AI and pydantic-evals, prompt design and grounding, LLM-as-judge evaluation, guardrails and adversarial testing, LangWatch, PHI de-identification (Deduce)
- **Languages**: Python, TypeScript, Scala, Java
- **Frameworks and libraries**: FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy/Alembic, PostgreSQL, Node.js/NestJS, Kafka, Spark/Databricks, Flink, pandas, React, React Native, Next.js, TailwindCSS, Playwright, Jest
- **Platforms**: Kubernetes, Docker, ArgoCD, AWS, Azure, Terraform, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, Sentry
- **Spoken languages**: Fluent in English, Dutch (NT2) and Serbian. Intermediate German and Russian.
